method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly). Firm-wide PwC benefits are in the PwC profile.
overview: Strategy& is PwC's strategy consulting business, formed when PwC acquired Booz & Company (closed 2014). It sells 'strategy through execution': strategy work that can draw on PwC's advisory, tax and assurance teams to implement it.
business_type: Strategy consulting inside a Big Four network

differentiators.text: Booz & Company heritage (roots in 1914) inside PwC; positioned as 'strategy, made real', combining strategy methods with PwC's network to carry clients from strategy through execution.
differentiators.significance: Expect strategy work that stays involved into implementation, unlike pure advice-only shops. The 'oldest strategy consultancy' framing is the firm's own.

tradeoffs.text: PwC US slowed campus hiring in 2025 and reportedly plans to recruit fewer graduates; Strategy& entry seats in the US are few.
tradeoffs.significance: Competitive; apply early in the campus cycle.

unknowns: Strategy&-specific mentorship, staffing and flexibility practices.
Whether US Strategy& entry roles sit on PwC's entry-level board or are hired separately.

sources.title: Bloomberg Law: Big Four layoffs and campus hiring
